company.description: Name of the hiring company, or null if the posting does not name it.

roleTitle.description: Job title as written in the posting, or null if absent.

seniority.description: Seniority level the posting asks for. UNSPECIFIED if it does not say.

requiredSkills.description: Technologies and skills stated as required. Short names such as Java or Spring Boot, at most 40, no duplicates.

niceToHaveSkills.description: Skills stated as optional, preferred or a plus. Empty if none.

workMode.description: Work arrangement, or null if the posting does not say.

location.description: City, region or country of the job, or null if absent.

languages.description: Human languages required, in English, such as English or Spanish. Empty if none are stated.

salary.description: Salary or range exactly as stated, including currency and period, or null if not stated.

summary.description: Neutral summary of the role in two or three sentences, in English.
